name: Adaptive Frequency Domain Filtering
definition: An optimization technique for frequency domain volume rendering that selects between a large and a small interpolation filter based on the local spectral energy of the 3D spectrum, reducing interpolation cost while maintaining image quality.
summary: Adaptive Frequency Domain Filtering optimizes volume rendering by using a preprocessing step to mark voxels, allowing the extraction phase to skip expensive multi-voxel support checks for regions with low spectral magnitude.
